propertySets.name: Pset_MechanicalFastenerBolt
propertySets.definition: Properties related to bolt-type fasteners. The properties of a whole set with bolt, washers and nut may be provided. Note, it is usually not necessary to transmit these properties in case of standardized bolts. Instead, the standard is referred to.

properties.name: ThreadDiameter
properties.definition: Nominal diameter of the thread, if different from the bolt's overall nominal diameter

properties.name: NutsCount
properties.definition: Count of nuts to be mounted on one bolt

properties.name: WashersCount
properties.definition: Count of washers to be mounted on one bolt

properties.name: HeadShape
properties.definition: Shape of the bolt's head, e.g. 'Hexagon', 'Countersunk', 'Cheese'

properties.name: KeyShape
properties.definition: If applicable, shape of the head's slot, e.g. 'Slot', 'Allen'
